dialogue.text: Kamar da kake fada, fasaha ta kasance da baki da kwararronsu, saboda kwararronsu ba tare da nazari ba.
dialogue.translation: As you argue, science has gaps in its knowledge because its knowledge is not complete.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: To, ga wani jigo na fasaha da muka kara mana kwararronsu da kwanaki.
dialogue.translation: Well, look at a scientific example that has reduced our knowledge over the days.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Da yawa muna da rinjaye game da wadannan baki, amma ba zan yi lafiya ba da su.
dialogue.translation: We have many debates about these gaps, but I won’t feel safe with them.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Baki ne, amma ya wuce wani hanya don samun lafiya a garemu.
dialogue.translation: It’s a gap, but it exceeds a way to achieve well-being in our case.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kasar da fasaha ta rage kwararronsa bisa wata hanya, ya kamata muyi lafiya.
dialogue.translation: The country where science has reduced its knowledge in a way must feel safe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kasar ta fada da wani rinjaye game da fasaha, amma ba ya zo da kwararronsa.
dialogue.translation: The country argued in a debate about science, but it did not add to its knowledge.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yaushe fasaha ta zo da wata hanya don tsira, amma kashin da muka kara da kwararronsu yake ne mutum ya shiga a gaba.
dialogue.translation: Maybe science has a way to survive, but the part we reduced in knowledge is what people will engage with in the future.

key_phrases.phrase: Yaushe muna fada da wani hanya don samun lafiya a fagen fasaha?
key_phrases.translation: How can we argue in a way to achieve well-being in the face of science?

key_phrases.phrase: Kasar da fasaha ta rage kwararronsa bisa wata hanya, ya kamata muyi lafiya.
key_phrases.translation: The country where science has reduced its knowledge in a way must feel safe.

key_phrases.phrase: Kamar da kake fada, fasaha ta kasance da baki da kwararronsu.
key_phrases.translation: As you argue, science has gaps in its knowledge.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yaya za a fita da wannan tsanani matsalar aiki, tun da yarda da tsakiya?
dialogue.translation: How can we resolve this important work issue in a way that shows sincerity and agreement?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Haka ne, kawai muna buƙatar bayyana hakan da sananne.
dialogue.translation: Yes, we just need to explain it clearly.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Idan muka suna suna bayyana harshe, dole ne mu ci gaba da tsakiya.
dialogue.translation: If we keep explaining the language, we must continue with sincerity.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Da yake, tun da madubi na da yawa da suka dace, za a fahimta a ƙarshe.
dialogue.translation: Because, since there are many fitting examples, it will be understood in the end.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: To, in da wake ne mu fitowa da shi a ƙarshe?
dialogue.translation: So, is the way to resolve it by coming out with it directly?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Haka ne, amma suna da aiki ne, ko kuwa muka yarda da sabuwar harshe.
dialogue.translation: Yes, but however, the work must be done, or we have to agree on a new approach.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wannan tsanani matsalar, haka ce ta ci gaba?
dialogue.translation: Is this important issue continuing in this way?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ba, amma kawai muna buƙatar bayyana tsakiya a cikin wake.
dialogue.translation: No, but we just need to explain sincerity in the approach.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yarda, hakanan za a ci gaba da tsanani matsalar aiki.
dialogue.translation: Agreed, then we will proceed with this important work issue.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ya nuna murna saboda muke kula da ƙasƙancin jama'a a wata ƙasa?
dialogue.translation: He showed satisfaction because we are taking care of the minority in that country.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Amma muna tun da shekaru da yawa, wannan matsala ta rage rame.
dialogue.translation: But we have been dealing with this problem for many years, it has continued much.

dialogue.text: Me kike sani ne tsalle don ka yarda da wannan tsari?
dialogue.translation: What do you know that makes you accept this arrangement?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ani, zan yi tunani, amma ba zan kara ba a kula tsalle ba.
dialogue.translation: Well, I will think, but I won't continue to take care of this responsibility.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: To, an samu wata hanya ta letsa abin da muka yi ba? Saboda wannan hanya ce ta kasance mai ƙarfi.
dialogue.translation: So, did we find a way to achieve what we did? Because this way is the strongest.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ina da murna da yaushe, amma kuma zan gama wa ƙasƙancin mutane wata hanya ta garshe ba.
dialogue.translation: I have satisfaction always, but I will also give the minority a direct way.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wannan da ya dace ne, saboda mun gama wa su hanya mai ƙarfi ne.
dialogue.translation: This is appropriate, because we gave them a strong way.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Da yaushe, zan kara da wata hanya mai tsalle saboda zan kula da su da yaushe.
dialogue.translation: Anyway, I will continue with a responsible way because I will take care of them always.

scenario: Discussing post-colonial perspectives in literature
frequency_note: words ranked ~3000–6000 by frequency of Hausa

vocabulary.translation: to come out, to emerge, to result

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wane ne wata hanya da ke nuna matsakaici game da labarai na fasaha ba? Bayyana mani.
dialogue.translation: Which approach reveals the total contradiction in cultural narratives? Show me.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ammattun mutane dama sun cika da wannan wasu suka fita game da fasaha na zamantakewa. Wane ne mai da saukin bayani a game da wannan?
dialogue.translation: Most people implement this, but some have emerged with entirely different cultural perspectives. Who has the most insightful opinion on this?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bisa wata nazariya da nawa dalili sun bayyana matsakaicin fasaha ta post-kolonial? Dubata ta da wata dalilai.
dialogue.translation: According to one theory, how many arguments reveal the cultural contradictions of post-colonial literature? Discuss it with supporting evidence.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Dai, wannan ya sa mu fahimta cikin game da halayen da suka faru a fasaha.
dialogue.translation: Just this will help us fully understand the events that occurred in the narrative.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yaya za mu bayyana matsakaicin fasaha a cikinsu a bayanin wannan nazariya? Da yaya za mu cika shi a fasaha na zamantakewa?
dialogue.translation: How will we present these contradictions in their context after this theory? And how will we implement it in cultural narratives?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ana buƙatar bayyana wata fasaha game da matsakaicin halayen da suka faru ba. Wane ne mai da wata fasaha mai zurfin bayani a game da wannan?
dialogue.translation: We need to present a narrative about the contradictions in these events. Who has a strong narrative with insightful evidence?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ammattun mutane da suka fara bayyana fasaha game da matsakaici ba, sun fita da wata halin da ba da wata adadin fasaha mai zurfin bayani.
dialogue.translation: The people who began presenting narratives about contradictions have emerged with a situation that lacks strong cultural evidence.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Wane ne mai da wata nan da ke da wata fasaha mai zurfin bayani a wata halin da ke da wata adadin fasaha mai zurfin bayani?
dialogue.translation: Who has the insightful opinion in a situation abundant with strong cultural narratives?

key_phrases.phrase: Wane ne wata hanya da ke nuna matsakaici game da labarai na fasaha ba?
key_phrases.translation: Which approach reveals the total contradiction in cultural narratives?

key_phrases.phrase: Bisa wata nazariya da nawa dalili sun bayyana matsakaicin fasaha ta post-kolonial?
key_phrases.translation: According to one theory, how many arguments reveal the cultural contradictions of post-colonial literature?

key_phrases.phrase: Da yaya za mu cika shi a fasaha na zamantakewa?
key_phrases.translation: And how will we implement it in cultural narratives?
